Name: Gluttony Combo
Description: Gluttony Combo - lalalazy fork of Gluttony Combo. XIVCombo for very lazy players.
Punchline: Lalalazy fork of Wrath Combo - XIVCombo for very lazy players.
Changelog:
v1.0.4.21 - Upstream Queueing Fix
- Integrated WrathCombo 1.0.4.7's improved recast queueing detour for reliable action queuing.

v1.0.4.20 - Dark Knight (DRK) TBN Enhancements
- Added EnemiesTargetingPlayerCount() utility helper to track aggressive hostiles targeting the player.
- Updated DRK non-boss mitigation to automatically cast The Blackest Night (TBN) when an incoming tankbuster is detected (via HasIncomingTankBusterEffect()).
- Updated DRK non-boss and boss mitigation to automatically cast TBN on cooldown during trash pulls (when 3 or more enemies target the player), bypassing standard health threshold gates for maximum active mitigation.
